brief:
Israel barred French left-wing politician Jean-Luc Mélenchon from entering the country, drawing sharp criticism from Paris, Al Jazeera English reported. The French government called the move "demagogic," characterizing it as an unjustified restriction on a prominent political figure.

The Israeli ban followed France's decision to prohibit a prominent Israeli settler from entering French territory, escalating diplomatic tensions between the two nations over their respective entry policies.
dek: Israel's move came after France banned a prominent Israeli settler from entering the country.
title: France condemns Israel's ban on left-wing leader Mélenchon
